args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18% following the latest deploy. Remediation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent version healthy in production, across all production regions. Rollback completed successfully and v2.3.0 is now live in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Service should be monitored to confirm recovery; root cause of the v2.3.1 failure pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Remediation:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release with a healthy status in production (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy). The rollback completed across all production regions.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure symptoms and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommendation:** Monitor checkout-api to confirm v2.3.0 restores health, and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before any re-attempted deploy.
